statement: Identity of the working repository is AeroTech.Ordering; preserve worktree and inspect drift from reviewed bootstrap.
Domain and Application dependencies conform to the physical layer contract; no transport/persistence business leakage.
One scoped transaction/session and one canonical projection writer; no last-registration-wins duplicate rails.
Inbox acceptance and its durable normalized work/facts are atomic; duplicate conflict is distinguished from unrelated database errors.
Outbox fact identity and payload survive retries, broker failure and process restart.
Create consumes exactly one previously captured, explicitly accepted preparation; no external calls or silent repricing.
Command replay is resolved before new eligibility; same key/hash returns original authorized result and different hash conflicts.
One preparation yields at most one Order even under different keys, concurrent clients or process restart.
OrderItem follows accepted priced boundary, not passenger/coupon/product type; OrderService has stable independent identity.
A sold air service is one traveler on one passenger segment; operational legs do not multiply services/coupons.
Current beneficiary/item/order ownership is consistent; historical membership is immutable and may outlive current ownership.
Sold pricing is immutable; quantity is not applied twice; original/sale valuations are not summed together.
Direction alone supplies sign; CustomerBalance alone contributes to CustomerTotal; settlement commission is not customer debt.
Allocation is per line/purpose/version value attribution and never additional money or refund entitlement.
Fare construction/coupling comes from source or remains explicitly opaque; itinerary shape never invents a pricing unit.
OrderDetails is committed atomically, rebuildable and readable with all external services offline.
Airline/customer/actor scope comes from authenticated authority; no cross-customer leakage through IDs, keys or read models.
Unknown validity/source assurance is not infinite or certified; live-candidate sandbox Orders cannot reach real sale effects.
Every external mutation has immutable durable intent, original effect key/profile/hash and exact target scope before dispatch.
Unknown is not rejection or success; recovery uses authoritative side-effect-free evidence and the same operation.
An active domain claim survives worker lease expiry; fences prevent stale workers from authorizing new effects.
Capacity outcomes are per target with exact quantity and coupling; partial/unknown batch is not fully confirmed.
FlightFlow is canonical capacity owner; only explicit seat requirements determine quantities, not PTC alone.
Owner hold expiry, release and commit are distinct; a timeout or local clock expiry does not prove resource release.
Coverage binds exact obligation identity/version/scope/currency and authoritative reference, not just sufficient numeric amount.
Guarantee, captured cash and pending/refund application are independent facts and not double-counted.
Document issue consumes an operation-bound funding authority; a stale transient coverage query cannot authorize issue.
Additional product funding is scoped to new/incremental obligations; prior applied funding is not charged again.
CanStartIssue may include a valid hold, but document commit needs committed required capacity, funding authority and document eligibility.
ETKT and EMD are separate roots; ticket coupon service identity and EMD purpose/association are explicit.
Stock namespace is unique, ranges do not overlap atomically, uncertain/reserved numbers are never randomly replaced or recycled.
Local issuance has one atomic document commit; external-authority partial outcomes retain each actual document and exact recovery identity.
Ledger is never an Issue gate; document facts do not silently duplicate commercial economic facts.
Cancellation, release, document void and refund are different effects; cancellation does not finalize with unresolved required release in reference profile.
Ancillary product, price, flight capacity and supplier execution owners are distinct; free/included does not mean no tracking or zero fake price.
Shared service beneficiaries and quantities are explicit; one room/car/pooled allowance is not multiplied per traveler.
Dependent services have a Keep/Replace/Cancel/ManualReview disposition when associated air scope changes.
EMD-A associates at coupon level; fee/deposit/residual EMD-S uses monetary/external value references, never fake flight service.
Void requires issuer/profile/control eligibility; document-only void does not erase commercial debt or imply payment refund.
Refund uses accepted authoritative historical pricing decision; reversal caps and tender payout caps are separate.
Refund commercial pivot and later payout have distinct evidence/events; payout replay never credits commercial value twice.
Exchange preserves old/new many-to-many lineage, source fare coupling, unchanged service identities and exact quote value treatment.
After an irreversible servicing pivot, unresolved cleanup recovers forward; do not reactivate old documents or start a new duplicate operation.
Disruption cases/options/deadlines belong externally; recording impact alone cannot rewrite price, itinerary or cancel scope.
High fanout is asynchronous per Order with stable work identities; no global transaction across a flight population.
DCS observations are idempotent per source event plus observation key and ordered by certified aspect/source revisions.
Operational schedule/seat/check-in/boarding cannot rewrite sold schedule/pricing or falsely set coupon Used.
Control and delivery facts may arrive during claims; retain them and re-evaluate eligibility rather than dropping inconvenient truth.
Traveler correction preserves identity and protected before/after history; OpenAir flight binding is explicit, Surface never consumes an air seat.
Split moves whole traveler/guardian scope with stable service IDs, immutable historic facts and balanced money/application transfers.
Shared service partition requires an authoritative partition plan; merge is not implemented by copying or summing Orders.
Group allocation plus release never exceeds confirmed capacity for EACH block; name materialization consumes existing blocks idempotently.
Group deposit/value applications transfer once; invalid bulk rows do not rerun accepted rows or duplicate charter charges.
CommercialVersion increments once per committed commercial mutation, not per event or remote result; other version scopes remain separate.
Deadlines have distinct owners; no universal Order TTL and no local rounding/FX/tax policy invented to fill gaps.
Framework/simulators do not depend on old business repositories or share an Ordering transaction with fake owner state.
A release enables only profiles actually certified for the deployed capabilities; no simulator or document structural check is production proof.
Unknown product/owner semantics fail explicitly with scoped evidence; future extension requires compatibility and regression proof.
Accepted decimal values and source provenance round-trip losslessly; field precision is explicit and overflow is rejected, not rounded.
Protected PII erasure does not delete immutable non-personal monetary/documentary lineage; events/logs minimize PII.
